title.zh: Thinking Machines 发布 Inkling 2 Mini：可在笔记本上跑的开源 MoE
title.en: Thinking Machines releases Inkling 2 Mini, an open-weight MoE meant to run on a laptop

summary.zh: Thinking Machines 在 2026-11-20 发布 Inkling 2 Mini：开源权重的 looped MoE，总参数 264 亿、激活 34 亿，循环后约 54 亿次权重激活，显存约 20GB，上下文最长 1M。官方把它定位为可在笔记本上跑的本地模型，并展示了在飞行模式的 MacBook Pro 上离线写出飞行模拟器的演示。11 月 20 日和 21 日的日报没有收录这次发布，11 月 23 日的日报才报道，并附上使用侧反馈；因此 reported_on 是 2026-11-23，happened_at 按官方发布日写作 2026-11-20。使用侧的速度数字是个人环境结果，不是官方基准，不写入 brief。
summary.en: Thinking Machines released Inkling 2 Mini on 2026-11-20: an open-weight looped mixture-of-experts model with 26.4B total parameters, 3.4B active, about 5.4B weight activations after looping, about 20GB of memory use, and up to 1M context. Officially it is a local model that can run on a laptop, and the launch included an offline flight-simulator demo on a MacBook Pro in airplane mode. The 20 and 21 November digests did not cover the launch; the 23 November digest did, with later usage feedback, so reported_on is 2026-11-23 and happened_at is 2026-11-20. Speed figures from individual setups are not official benchmarks and do not belong in the brief.

brief.zh: Thinking Machines 发布开源权重模型 Inkling 2 Mini：264 亿总参数、激活 34 亿，约 20GB 显存，上下文最长 1M，定位为可在笔记本上跑的本地模型。
brief.en: Thinking Machines released open-weight Inkling 2 Mini: 26.4B parameters, 3.4B active, about 20GB memory, and 1M context, meant to run on a laptop.

why.zh: 这是窗口里一次完整的开源小模型发布。报道日按首次写入日报的 11 月 23 日，发生日按官方 11 月 20 日。
why.en: A complete open-weight small-model launch in this window. The reporting day is 23 November, when the digest first covered it; the happened day is the official 20 November release.
